#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    int a[3], b[3];
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        cin >> a[i];
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        cin >> b[i];
    }

    int beats[] = {1, 2, 0};
    int losesTo[] = {2, 0, 1};
    int max = 0, min = 0;

        if (extra > 0) {
            min += extra;
        }
    }

    cout << min << " " << max << endl;
    return 0;
}
